ui.notifications.bulk.dismiss_all.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.dismiss_all.context: Button in the notification-list toolbar. Dismiss all matching update notifications, including beyond the loaded page. Does not settle pending asks; confirmation covers hidden results.

ui.notifications.bulk.read_hint.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.read_hint.context: Tooltip on Mark read. All is the existing All tab name: read updates remain available there. Keep its translation consistent with ui.notifications.filter.all.

ui.notifications.bulk.dismiss_hint.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.dismiss_hint.context: Tooltip on dismiss controls. Removes update notifications from the inbox, not source conversation content. Undo is the existing toast action (ui.notifications.toast.undo).

ui.notifications.bulk.frozen_hint.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.frozen_hint.context: Tooltip beside selected count. A server snapshot freezes the result at selection time; later arrivals do not join the operation. Not a frozen/unresponsive application.

ui.notifications.bulk.confirm_title.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.confirm_title.context: Confirmation heading. count is the number of eligible update notifications, excluding unanswered asks. ICU numeric plural; fit a medium dialog with wrapping.

placeholders.count: integer count of eligible updates; pluralize

ui.notifications.bulk.beyond_page.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.beyond_page.context: Confirmation paragraph shown only when the snapshot covers more matching updates than the loaded rows. Does not mean just the visible scroll viewport.

ui.notifications.bulk.asks_hint.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.asks_hint.context: Safety warning. Ask is a question an agent is waiting for the user to answer. Bulk dismiss leaves it alone; settling it separately wakes the agent and cannot be undone. Never describe ask settlement as reversible.

ui.notifications.bulk.review_asks.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.review_asks.context: Secondary button opens the existing ask details, without dismissing anything. User must separately choose the ask-specific irreversible action.

ui.notifications.bulk.select_error.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.select_error.context: Failure toast for frozen-result preview; no selection or write was confirmed. Short, retryable, no claim that anything changed.

ui.notifications.bulk.update_required.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.update_required.context: Disabled control tooltip on an older backend missing notification_bulk_selection. Local Operator is a product name and remains unchanged.

ui.notifications.bulk.partial.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.partial.context: Receipt for a partial write/Undo. changed and skipped are locale-formatted numeric strings. Do not imply skipped items changed or were restored.

ui.notifications.bulk.exclusion_limit.tone: concise, calm, explicit about scope and reversibility
ui.notifications.bulk.exclusion_limit.context: Toast when trying to uncheck more than the server limit of 500 exceptions to a frozen all-results selection. Existing selection is preserved; clear then select individual rows instead.
